Input: Initialize network and service parameters, including W_m, W_s, D, \epsilon, \lambda, p, H, M_{k,z}, M_{\text{max}}, and set iteration number m as 0.
Output: A set of optimal solutions for the stationary task offloading policy, a_{k,z}^*, the radio resource slicing ratios, \gamma_k^*(k \in \{0,1,...,n\}), and the average fraction of radio resources reserved for AVs in each road zone, f_{k,z}^*.
1 do
2m \leftarrow m + 1;
3Update the sliced radio resources on BSs at the beginning of iteration m based on \gamma_k^{(m-1)} obtained in iteration (m - 1);
4With \gamma_k^{(m-1)}, run Algorithm 1 to determine the stationary task offloading policy a_{k,z}^{(m)};
5Determine f_{k,z}^{(m)} based on a_{k,z}^{(m)} as in (25);
6Given a_{k,z}^{(m)} and f_{k,z}^{(m)}, solve (P3) to obtain radio resource slicing ratios \gamma_k^{(m)} in iteration m;
7while a_{k,z}^{(m)} \neq a_{k,z}^{(m-1)} for AVs under any S_k;
